name: ControlResell
description: Ops OS for pro resellers (Vinted, Shopify, etc.) — listings, negotiation, relisting, sales/purchase tracking. France-first.

mentions.evidence: ~$21.5k MRR, 442 active subscriptions, ~$24.1k L30, ~$140k all-time, founded Jan 2025. Last sync Sep 29, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Pick one marketplace vertical (resale, repair, trades) and own the daily workflow — YouTube + podcast as acquisition.

whyItPrints: Resellers drown in listing chores; a $30–120/mo ops layer on that grind is pure vertical SaaS.
whyThisMatters:
Ops tool for people who resell for a living. Vinted first, Shopify too. The site is in French. The promise is that the boring part of resale gets done for you, so you're not living inside the marketplace screens all day. There's an app you download and a web app.

They list the chores and mark a bunch of them automatic. Writing the listing. Scheduling posts across the week. Messaging people who favorited something. Negotiating. Republishing and dropping the price. Grabbing the shipping label. Updating the books. A banner on the page calls out the Vinted hookup. Analytics and syncing more than one platform sit further down, same system.

Not a generic inventory app. The person already sells, often lots of small items, and loses hours to messages and relists. The page talks about getting that time back. They also show running totals of conversations, automated messages, and listings. Their counters, not a payment-processor export.

People keep it on because they've got stock to move every day. What it turns on is the listing copy, the negotiation, the relist, the label, and the books.
